d: Rashtriy janta dal (RJD) ke neta tejasvi yadav dvara bidupur pul ka nam 'akshayvat setu' rakhne ko lekar die gae bayan par bhartiy janta parti (BJP) ke neta mrityunjay tivari ne pratikriya di hai. midiya se batchit karte hue bhajpa neta mrityunjay tivari ne tejasvi yadav ki mang par saval uthate hue purvavarti sarkar ke karyakal ka ullekh kiya hai.
